stories.title: Follow live: Yankees hold lead over Red Sox after Wells' RBI single
White Sox top Astros in Game 1; first playoff win in 5 years
stories.summary: The White Sox beat the Astros 6-3 in Game 1 of their AL Wild Card Series, the club's first playoff win since 2021.

stories.title: Mattingly's early move to Duran, 'our best guy,' backfires in loss
stories.summary: Don Mattingly wanted the Phillies' best reliever on the mound as early as possible in the opener of a best-of-three NL Wild Card Series against the Braves, but the move backfired when All-Star closer Jhoan Duran allowed a three-run homer in a Game 1 loss.

stories.title: Sources: NBA reviewing finalists' bids for Vegas team in $12-13B range
stories.summary: The NBA is expected to select the winning bid for owner of the Las Vegas expansion team from among three finalist groups: Nancy Walton Laurie and Bill Laurie; Steve Apostolopoulos and Marc Lasry; and Bill Foley and Jerry Colangelo.

stories.title: Clark's monster effort keeps Fever alive, helps force Game 3 vs. Aces
stories.summary: Caitlin Clark became the first player in league history to produce a points-assists double-double in the first half of a playoff game and finished with 27 points and 15 assists in a 99-89 win over the Aces to keep the Fever alive.
